material_blocker.finding: The replay/measured-evidence preimage semantics changed while historical persisted rows were minted under the prior v1 identity semantics. Reusing the v1 namespace across the semantic change can allow an old execution to miss the new identity lookup and mint a second packet/token increment after upgrade.

goodman_law: the repeated exact-blob and concurrent tests are reproducibility inside one implementation/evidence family, not independent semantic replication
new envelope rows from the same measured execution are not new evidence
model consensus, worker count, token volume, or shared ancestry cannot mint dataset, semantic, HCU, EntityOS, BASE, or canonical credit
